relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: Knockdown of TRPV4 (confirmed through qRT-PCR) significantly decreased both PGE2 and IL-6 levels (Fig. 1E).

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV4 mRNA expression more than triples in the presence of IL-1β

relationships.subject: 5(6)-EET
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings show that 5(6)-EET activates calcium flux through TRPV4, which can be significantly attenuated by HC067047.

relationships.subject: Maresin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that maresin 1 reduced calcium flux whether initiated by 4αPDD or IL-1β (Fig. 7A).

relationships.subject: HC067047
relationships.evidence_quote: Activity is blocked by the TRPV4 antagonist HC067047, denoting specificity to TRPV4.

key_findings: Inflammation (IL-1β) and 5(6)-EET activate TRPV4 in vulvar fibroblasts in a feed-forward loop that increases PGE2 production.
Maresin 1 halts TRPV4 calcium signaling and a DHA/SPM-precursor supplement relieved vulvar allodynia in mice.
